title: FORGE Session Telemetry
description: One JSON object per line in sessions.jsonl. Emitted by /rise, /care, /harvest at task close.

schema_version.description: 1.1 adds started_at, git_stats and measured (all optional). 1.0 lines remain valid.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at task close.

started_at.description: v1.1. ISO 8601 UTC time the workflow started (recorded by tools/forge_session.py start).

iterations.description: Iteration count (relevant for C-A-R-E loops; default 1 for R-I-S-E and HARVEST).

wall_time_sec.description: Seconds from start to task close. Measured when listed in `measured`; otherwise self-reported.

git_stats.description: v1.1. Working-tree change since the session started, measured with git by tools/forge_session.py.

new_untracked_files.description: Untracked files that appeared during the session; their lines count toward lines_added.

baseline_dirty.description: True if the working tree already had uncommitted changes at start; those are included in the counts.

measured.description: v1.1. Fields filled mechanically by tools/forge_session.py rather than self-reported.

outcome.description: success = all gates passed; partial = some gates failed but task delivered; failed = task not delivered; escalated = handed off to different workflow.

prompt_hash.description: SHA-256 of the raw user prompt, hex-encoded. First 16 chars minimum.

raw_prompt.description: Only populated if FORGE_TELEMETRY_RAW=1 environment variable is set. Privacy-sensitive.

notes.description: Free-form AI commentary on what worked, what failed, what to improve. Mined by tools/forge_learn.py promote.
